verse.verse_3: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
verse.verse_4: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
verse.verse_5: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
verse.verse_6: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
verse.verse_7: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
verse.verse_8: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
verse.verse_9: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
verse.verse_10: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
verse.verse_11: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
verse.verse_12: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
verse.verse_13: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
verse.verse_14: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
verse.verse_15: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
verse.verse_16: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
verse.verse_17: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
verse.verse_18: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
verse.verse_19: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
verse.verse_20: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
verse.verse_21: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
verse.verse_23: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
verse.verse_24: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
verse.verse_25: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
verse.verse_26: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
verse.verse_27: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
verse.verse_28: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
verse.verse_30: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
verse.verse_31: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_32: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
verse.verse_33: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
verse.verse_34: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
verse.verse_35: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
verse.verse_36: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
verse.verse_37: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
verse.verse_38: So I do call to witness what ye see,
verse.verse_40: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
verse.verse_41: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
verse.verse_43: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_44: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
verse.verse_45: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
verse.verse_46: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
verse.verse_47: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
verse.verse_48: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
verse.verse_49: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
verse.verse_50: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
verse.verse_51: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
verse.verse_52: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
